Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository instructions.

Push only to `https://github.com/Sophie-32/canonical.com`; `origin` must name that
fork. Verify its push URL before every push. Never push to Canonical upstream.
Follow [workshop ownership](../docs/workshop.md). Use an isolated checkout and
branch. Model reviewers must record actual identities, task and tested revision;
availability in Copilot is independent of standalone model CLIs on PATH.
S owns personas/journeys on `workshop/s-journeys-personas`; L owns the rest on
`workshop/l-evaluation-records`. Read your brief under `docs/handoffs/` and the
entry assumptions in `.kb/design/assumptions.md` before launching review tasks.
